description: Convert several statements (or reuse statement_ids from the last hour) and combine them into one set of accounts: finds missing months (gaps), overlapping periods, duplicated transactions (kept once) and balances that do not carry over. Returns the accounts, problems, counts and links to one combined Excel or CSV file (valid one hour). Uses the user's DocFig API key.

files.description: Statements to convert and combine, each with file_path, file_url or file_base64.

file_base64.description: The file's bytes, base64-encoded (up to 20 MB decoded).

file_path.description: Path of a statement file on this computer.

file_url.description: Direct https download link to the statement (PDF, JPG, PNG or HEIC, up to 20 MB). Must be publicly reachable.

password.description: Password for a locked PDF. Used once in memory, never stored or logged.

save_to.description: Optional: a folder, or a path ending in .xlsx or .csv, to save the combined workbook.

statement_ids.description: statement_id values of statements converted in the last hour (from convert_statement or an earlier combine_statements call).

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for all conversions. Default 90.

name: combine_statements
title: Combine several statements
